_comment: Copied from reference implementation and upstream reference (32 sample bodies rebuilt from the servers' format strings: L=100000, P=95000, M=32000). Used by test/bench/mock-styles.test.ts.

map._comment: Default upstream error map for kitzur (draft from reference implementation). Regexes are JavaScript syntax (named groups), matched case-sensitively against the raw response body text (and against every SSE event payload for in-stream errors). Named groups: window, prompt, completion, total, maxInput, chars, atLeast. 'lowerBound' means the prompt number is only a lower bound (tokenization was truncated at maxInput+1). Order matters: first match wins. 'status' null = any status (incl. in-stream after HTTP 200). Use the optional 'flags' field (e.g. 'i') instead of inline modifiers: Node 20 RegExp has no (?i:...) support.
